1.21.1.0.1636.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Compatibility ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Advancements ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1635.0

**Advancement progress**

One hidden advancement now fills its title bar as you get closer, without saying how much is left.

### 0.1634.0

**Behind the scenes**

Small behind-the-scenes improvements.

### 0.1633.0

**PlayerMobs show some of their gear**

Some PlayerMobs now show a little of what they carry. YDM's Weapon Master also sits better alongside Dungeon Train in creative.
1.21.1.0.1633.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Community ×2 · Compatibility ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1632.0

**More photo albums for supporters**

Anyone who has supported the game can now keep more than one photo album: one extra for any donation, and 10 for every A$10. Once your first album is full, an album you find on the train is your newest album half the time, and one of your full albums the rest of the time. A crafted album is always your newest one.

- Your photo album now follows you to every computer you play on

### 0.1631.0

**Essential Tweaks and more mods count for fair play**

Running Essential Tweaks alongside Essential no longer puts your run in Free Play. A batch of recently approved mods now also count offline, from your very first launch.

- Essential Tweaks approved for fair play
- Armor Visibility now counts, it was approved under the wrong name before
- Shoulder Surfing, Legendary Tooltips, Just Enough Characters, Armor HUD, Cubes Without Borders, Explosive Enhancement, Weapon Master and Cinematic Interactions are approved offline too

### 0.1630.0

**Whitelist approval notes**

When a mod you suggested for the whitelist, or commented on, gets approved, a note now lands in your inbox on the main menu. The inbox window also shows notes sent to you outside of Discord, which it used to miss.

- Suggested a mod and it got approved? You will hear about it on the main menu.
- Inbox notes from Dungeon Train itself now show up in the window instead of a connection error.
1.21.1.0.1629.0:
**Bug Fix ×1 · Books ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1629.0

**Player-written letters burn, and a new way to earn A Library In Motion**

Player-written letters taken from a lectern now burn when dropped, like every other lectern book. A Library In Motion is now earned the first time you finish a story written by another player.

- Player-written lectern letters now burn when dropped
- A Library In Motion: finish a story written by another player
1.21.1.0.1628.0:
**Behind the Scenes ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Books ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1628.0

**Finished stories no longer repeat in new worlds**

Once you've read a narrative story to the end, lecterns stop offering it, in any world, until you've finished every other story. Your reading now carries across worlds, so each new world brings you closer to finishing the stories and to discovering player-written ones.

- A finished story stays out of lecterns until every story is finished
- Finishing a story in one world unlocks its follow-up stories in every world
- Player-written stories unlock based on how much you've read across all worlds
- Re-read stories now start at letter 1 and continue in order

### 0.1627.0

**Faster update checks behind the scenes**

Updates now move through testing faster, because changes waiting to go in no longer trip over each other.

### 0.1626.0

**Faster build checks**

Build checks reuse their cached downloads again, so changes are verified sooner.
1.21.1.0.1625.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Bug Fix ×1 · Editor ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Train ×1 · Loot ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1625.0

**A new vault**

A new kind of trial vault now turns up on the train.

### 0.1623.0

**Launcher world shortcuts open the menu**

Every world is one run, so launcher buttons that jump straight back into an old world now open the main menu instead. Start a new run from there.

### 0.1622.0

**Candle and flower pot variety**

Flower pots around the train now grow a different plant each time, and the Train Editor can now choose how many candles stand on a block, whether they are lit, and which plants a flower pot can hold.

- Flower pots around the train now hold a random plant.
- Train Editor: candles can be set to a fixed or random count, and lit, unlit or random.
- Train Editor: a flower pot can pick from every plant, or from a list of plants you choose.

### 0.1621.0

**Burrito timing**

Burrito timing tweak.
1.21.1.0.1620.0:
**New Content ×2 · Loot ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Train ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1619.0

**More trial vaults**

Two new trial vault layouts can turn up on the train, each with its own loot.

**Bundles in loot**

Bundles can now turn up in starting loot and in vases.

### 0.1618.0

**Back on Track fix**

Back on Track no longer triggers when it shouldn't.
1.21.1.0.1617.0:
**New Content ×1 · Loot ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1617.0

**Loot rebalance**

Some treasure is easier to come by and some is rarer, and a few rooms have been reworked.

- Ominous trial vault rewards have been boosted, with new loot
- A few rooms got new layouts and loot spots
1.21.1.0.1616.0:
**Bug Fix ×1 · Mobs ×1**

### 0.1616.0

**Digging mobs leave the floor alone**

Mobs that dig through walls to reach you, Player Mobs included, no longer mine the carpet, slabs or paths under their feet mid-fight.
1.21.1.0.1615.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Performance ×1 · Advancements ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1614.0

**Update check fix**

The version label on the title screen and pause menu tells you again when a newer version of Dungeon Train is out.

### 0.1613.0

**Mod of the Year nominations**

CurseForge's Mod of the Year is open for nominations, and if you've rated Dungeon Train highly, a short popup now invites you to nominate the modpack and then the mod. Pick Already did or nominate once and it won't ask again.

**Advancement change**

One hidden advancement now builds up over time instead of asking for a single big moment.

### 0.1612.0

**Lag report fix**

Lag detection and the offer to send a lag report now only run on recent versions of the mod. Older versions skip them entirely.
1.21.1.0.1611.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1611.0

**New secret advancement**

There is a new hidden advancement to discover.
1.21.1.0.1610.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Bug Fix ×1 · Editor ×1 · World ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1610.0

**Nether fix**

A few small fixes in the Nether.

### 0.1609.0

**Offset buttons in the editor**

The editor's template toolbar has a new Offset button. It opens a row of arrows that slide every block in the plot you are standing in, with a box to set how far each press moves. The preview model updates as you press.

- Six arrows: left/right, down/up, and the two depth directions
- Type a distance from 1 to 64 blocks per press
- Blocks pushed past one side come back in on the other, and every press can be undone
1.21.1.0.1608.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Bug Fix ×3 · Menus & UI ×3 · World ×2 · Performance ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1606.0

**Advancement fix**

A hidden advancement that some players had earned was not unlocking. It does now.

**Community Rewards: first gift is the smallest**

Each Community Reward now starts at its own amount and only goes up while another reward that costs more to run alongside it is on, so whichever is given first is the smaller gift. A grey line on the card says which reward is raising it.

- Two Streams now starts at $100 AUD.
- The Contribute page's gift header is shorter.

### 0.1605.0

**Send a lag report from chat**

If the game freezes for a few seconds, a line in chat offers to send your log to the developer so the freeze can be tracked down. It only asks after you've played for a while, at most every half hour, and No stops it for the session.

### 0.1604.0

**Underground lakes in some caves**

Some lush caves deep inside the mountains were nearly dry. They now fill with proper underground lakes, deep in places, the way lush caves should. Only newly explored areas change.

### 0.1603.0

**High effect and enchantment levels show their number**

In the Dungeon Train modpacks, effect and enchantment levels above X now read properly. Tooltips, your effect list and a mob's details show the real level instead of dropping the number or printing a stray text key.

- Strong mob buffs late in the train now show their full level
- Over-cap enchantments read as numerals in tooltips

### 0.1602.0

**Lush caves come alive**

Lush caves inside some of the mountains along the line were strangely empty. They now fill with axolotls, glow squid, fish, bats and the usual cave monsters, like lush caves anywhere else.
1.21.1.0.1601.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Community ×2 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1601.0

**Advancement cleanup**

One hidden advancement that was out of reach in practice has been retired. It no longer counts toward completing the advancements.

### 0.1600.0

**Stream chat filter stays current**

When a word is retired from the stream chat filter, it stops being hidden straight away, with no mod update needed.

### 0.1599.0

**Gentler stream chat filter**

The Live Eye filter is less extreme to everyday swearing. Slurs and the stronger words are filtered exactly as before.
1.21.1.0.1598.0:
**New Content ×2 · New Feature ×1 · Bug Fix ×1 · Train ×1 · Loot ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1598.0

**Photo progress in chat**

When a photo counts toward an advancement you have already discovered, chat now tells you how far along you are.

### 0.1597.0

**Crystal fix**

Fixed an issue with End Crystals.

### 0.1595.0

**Two new dimensional carriages**

Two new dimensional carriages can turn up further along the line. Watch your step.

**Name update**

More names.
1.21.1.0.1594.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Bug Fix ×2 · Editor ×2 · Behind the Scenes ×2 · Train ×1 · Loot ×1 · Advancements ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1594.0

**Trees on the train snap off**

Trees you grow on top of the train now break off when they hit a hill or tunnel, just like bamboo, dropping their wood instead of carving through the world.

- Works for trees, huge mushrooms and huge fungi grown on a carriage

### 0.1593.0

**Advancement fix**

A small advancement fix.

### 0.1592.0

**See who is live on your TV**

Wearing a TV now shows who is live in a line under the picture. With two streams on, each picture names its own streamer. Turn it off in Options, Stream, Who's live.

### 0.1590.0

**Piglin fix**

Piglin fix.

**Train Editor variant saving**

Block variants now save the same way in every Train Editor plot. Variant pools in carriage plots keep all their settings when saved, and clearing every variant from a plot removes the leftover file.

### 0.1589.0

**Editor plot lifecycle shared across template kinds**

Behind the scenes, the Train Editor's track, pillar, stairs, tunnel, carriage and whole-carriage plots now share one enter / stamp / save / clear routine instead of carrying their own copy each. Entering a named track-side variant from the X menu now lands on that variant's own plot rather than the row's default.

- One plot lifecycle for six editor kinds; the old entry points still work
- Go here on a named track, pillar, stairs or tunnel variant lands on that plot

### 0.1588.0

**Swap your Live Eye for one you find**

Already carrying a Live Eye? You can now pick up another one you find on the ground. The new one is yours and your old one turns into a TV. Wearing yours or live? Then it stays where it is for someone else.
1.21.1.0.1587.0:
**Bug Fix ×5 · Editor ×2 · Mobs ×2 · Books ×2 · Advancements ×2 · Behind the Scenes ×2 · Translations ×1**

### 0.1586.0

**Note echo fix**

A fix for echoes sent by Love Notes and Death Notes.

**Editor menu fixes**

Train Editor menus now send the same commands everywhere. Setting a track weight now needs a variant name. Removing a portal room removes the room you picked even when you are not standing in it. Unsaved chunk frames can now be saved by name with the save command.

### 0.1584.0

**Advancement fix**

Starting a new world is a little tidier with advancements you have already earned.

### 0.1583.0

**Editor tidy-up**

Behind-the-scenes cleanup of the train editor's menus. Editor menus now close properly when you leave the world.

### 0.1582.0

**Coffee Table Book fix**

Coffee Table Book now asks for the same biomes as Terra Omnia, so every photo slot can be filled.

- Biomes you had already photographed now count towards Terra Omnia.

### 0.1581.0

**Death Note trophy fix**

The head you take from a Death Note echo now wears its author's skin, the same face the echo wore, even on offline servers.

**Translation fixes**

Some translated text now reads more clearly.
1.21.1.0.1580.0:
# Deeper down the line, the sky gets dangerous

![Deeper down the line, the sky gets dangerous](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/comet-shower.gif)

Deeper down the line, the sky is no longer empty. Something has started coming down out of the dark.

Listen for it. And when the sky fills up, keep your head down.

*The further you go, the more of it there is.*

**Editor ×2 · Behind the Scenes ×2 · New Feature ×1 · World ×1**

### 0.1580.0

**Editor housekeeping**

Behind-the-scenes tidy-up of how the editor stores templates. Removing your own edit of a built-in template now brings the original back straight away.

### 0.1578.0

**The deeper dark spreads**

The deeper dark no longer keeps to its own stretch of the line. Keep an eye out for its sculk and gloom in places you thought you knew.

**Editor housekeeping**

Behind-the-scenes tidy-up of how the Train Editor stamps, enters and views its plots. Nothing changes in how you build; the half-carriage row in the Whole section now fills in with the rest when you open it.

- Editor housekeeping: every plot kind is handled the same way under the hood
- Whole section: half-carriage plots fill in with the rest of the section
1.21.1.0.1577.0:
**Bug Fix ×5 · Books ×3 · Performance ×2 · Mobs ×2 · Editor ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1577.0

**Note echo fix**

An echo sent by a Love Note or a Death Note now arrives wearing its author's own skin, not a stand-in.

### 0.1576.0

**Less lag while Distant Horizons generates far terrain**

With Distant Horizons on, its far-terrain generation could freeze the game for a second or two at a time while the train rolled. Those freezes are gone.

### 0.1574.0

**Editor housekeeping**

The Train Editor's plots share one set of plumbing now, whichever kind of template you are working on. Leaving the editor takes you straight back to where you came in, however many areas you wandered through.

- One exit from anywhere in the editor.

### 0.1573.0

**Smoother ride near water**

Crossing rivers, lakes and oceans is easier on the server: the train no longer costs extra tick time while the water around it settles. Water still stays out of the carriages.

- Fewer freezes when the world around the train fills with water.

### 0.1572.0

**Book stack fix**

Reading a book from a stack of identical copies now burns only the copy you read. The rest stay in your inventory to read later.

**Note story fix**

A note's story no longer arrives twice in the same life.

### 0.1571.0

**Mobs that fall onto the tracks stay there**

Mobs knocked off the train onto the tracks near you no longer vanish. They stay down on the rails and get slowly hurt while carriages roll over them.

### 0.1570.0

**Text fix**

A small text fix.
1.21.1.0.1569.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1569.0

**Watch the other stream while you stream**

While you stream and another player is live too, the box in your corner can now show your stream, theirs, both or nothing.

- Click the box in your inventory to switch it, or pick where it starts in Options, Stream.
- In your inventory the box now sits behind your menus and comes to the front when you hover it.
1.21.1.0.1568.0:
**Bug Fix ×1 · Train ×1**

### 0.1568.0

**No more sudden jumps when revisiting carriages**

Walking back along the train and then forward again could suddenly throw you several carriages ahead, into the walls of a carriage you had not reached yet. Carriages you return to now stay exactly where they belong, and so do you.
1.21.1.0.1567.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Bug Fix ×1 · Community ×1 · Train ×1**

### 0.1566.0

**Taking off the Live Eye passes the stream on**

When a streamer takes off their Live Eye, anyone watching with a TV on their head is now offered the stream, just like when a streamer dies. First click wins.

**Dimensional carriage fix**

Explosions inside a dimensional carriage now leave the same damage everywhere they should, so a wall you blew open stays open.
1.21.1.0.1565.0:
**Bug Fix ×1 · Train ×1 · Loot ×1**

### 0.1565.0

**Dimensional carriage fix**

Rooms inside a dimensional carriage now stay as you left them, including the parts you changed from the room next door. Step back onto the train and come back, and what you took or broke is still gone.
1.21.1.0.1564.0:
**New Feature ×4 · Bug Fix ×3 · Balance ×3 · World ×2 · Mobs ×2 · Advancements ×2 · Performance ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1564.0

**Exploration fix**

A hidden advancement is fairer, and the world has a little more variety further along.

### 0.1563.0

**Lag fix**

Fixed a lag spike on one stretch of the journey, where loose terrain could collapse all at once as the train arrived.

### 0.1562.0

**Replay Mod fix**

Replay Mod now keeps its camera from the first moment of a recording. Keyframed shots of your spawn onto the train render the way you set them, instead of holding one still frame.

### 0.1561.0

**Balance tweak**

A small balance adjustment.

### 0.1560.0

**Advancement progress you can check**

One hidden exploration advancement now remembers your progress for good, across lives and worlds, and clicking it on the advancements screen shows what you have done and what is left.

- Progress toward it is never lost, not even when you die
- Click it to see a full list, with a scrollbar
- If you had earned its earlier version, it is now a bigger goal, and you start with your progress carried over

### 0.1559.0

**Mobs dig more slowly**

Mobs get Haste later in a run and it grows much more slowly, so digging mobs break through your defences more slowly at high difficulty.

### 0.1558.0

**Creakings get potion effects**

Creakings now get potion effects as the run gets harder, just like the other monsters on the train.
1.21.1.0.1557.0:
**Bug Fix ×4 · Mobs ×2 · Performance ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1557.0

**Mob fix**

Mobs fighting you on the train no longer sometimes turn invisible after a lag spike while still attacking.

### 0.1556.0

**Lag fix**

Fixed long freezes that could hit during fights on the train, or right after loading back into a world.

### 0.1555.0

**Pets keep up with you on the train**

Tamed pets that catch up with you on the train now land on the carriage beside you, instead of getting stuck in the floor or falling off the side.

### 0.1554.0

**Twitch prompt fix**

Tagging the developer or another player in chat no longer asks you to connect a Twitch channel. The Twitch prompt now only appears while you are streaming with the Live Eye.
1.21.1.0.1553.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Books ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1553.0

**Death Note trophy**

Kill the echo a Death Note sent after you and you take its author's head as well as the note.

### 0.1552.0

**TV labels**

TVs now say whether they're on or off, and which stream they're set to, when you hover them in your inventory, so you can tell your TV stacks apart.

### 0.1551.0

**Photos in shulker boxes keep their pictures**

Photos you keep in a shulker box or bundle inside your Ender Chest now still show their picture when you start a new run, instead of turning into blank paper.

- Photos in shulker boxes and bundles in the Ender Chest keep their pictures from one run to the next
